title: A Concise Bounded Description
description: One Instance, the Work it instantiates, and the resources they name, in a single document.
$comment:
A CBD is an array of resources and not a different kind of thing, so this is an envelope and nothing more: each member is checked against the per-resource dialect exactly as it would be on its own.

Two differences from a stored record, neither of which needs saying here. bf:hasInstance and bf:instanceOf embed the whole node rather than holding a bare URI, because the other resource is in the document; the dialect already allows that, since a reference is open and an embedded resource is a reference carrying more. And a description node keeps no @id: framing several resources at once makes a processor label them, and those labels address nothing outside the document, which is the rule the dialect already states.

@graph.description: The resources described, each a Work, Instance, Hub or Item.
